# CLAUDE.md

This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with code in this repository.
```

     4→
     5→This application is a tool for uploading PDF files and analyzing their content using Mistral AI's OCR capabilities.

     7→## Getting Mistral AI API Key

     9→1. Access [Mistral AI](https://mistral.ai/) to create an account or log in

    13→## Vercel Blob Setup
    14→
    15→Before deploying the application, you need to set up Vercel Blob storage:
    16→
    17→1. **Create a Vercel project**
    18→
    19→   - Access [Vercel](https://vercel.com/) to sign up/log in
    20→   - Click "New Project" to create a new project
    21→
    22→2. **Create a Vercel Blob store**
    23→
    24→   - Select the "Storage" tab in the project dashboard
    25→   - Click the "Connect Database" button
    26→   - Select "Blob" in the "Create New" tab and click the "Continue" button
    27→   - Configure the following settings:
    28→     - Name: Any name (e.g., "PDF Storage")
    29→     - Select "Create a new Blob store"
    30→     - Select the environments where you want to add environment variables (typically all environments)
    31→     - Optionally change the environment variable prefix in "Advanced Options"
    32→   - Click the "Create" button to create the store
    33→

    35→
    36→   - When the Blob store is created, the following environment variable will be automatically added to your project:

    38→   - To use this environment variable in your local development environment, pull the environment variables using Vercel CLI:

    43→Once these settings are complete, you can proceed with deploying the application.

    49→1. **Clone the repository**
    50→

    52→   git clone https://github.com/link2004/pdf2md.git
    53→   cd pdf2md
    54→   ```
    55→
    56→2. **Copy the .env.example file**
    57→
    58→   ```bash
    59→   cp .env.example .env
    60→   ```
    61→
    62→3. **Set up the required environment variables in the .env file**
    63→
    64→   - Get `BLOB_READ_WRITE_TOKEN` from your Vercel dashboard and set it
    65→   - Get `MISTRAL_API_KEY` from your Mistral AI account and set it

   105→## Using the Application
   106→
   107→### Initial Setup
   108→
   109→1. Access the application and register/login if required
   110→2. Create a "New Project" from the home page
   111→
   112→### Uploading and Analyzing PDFs
   113→
   114→1. Click on the "Upload PDF" button to open the file selection dialog
   115→2. Select the PDF file you want to analyze (multiple files are also supported)
   116→   - Note: For server uploads, file size must be 20MB or less
   117→   - Try clearing your browser cache if you encounter issues
   118→3. Click on the "Upload" button to upload the PDF to Vercel Blob storage
   119→4. After the upload is complete, click on the "Analyze with Mistral AI" button
   120→5. Wait a few seconds to minutes for the analysis to complete (depending on the size and complexity of the PDF)
   121→
   122→### Reviewing and Editing Analysis Results
   123→
   124→1. The analysis results will be automatically displayed in Markdown format
   125→2. You can freely edit the content in the text editor
   126→3. Click on the "Save" button to save your edits
   127→4. Use the "Preview" tab to see how the Markdown will be rendered
   128→
   129→### Exporting Markdown
   130→
   131→1. Click on the "Export" button and select the export format:
   132→   - Markdown file (.md)
   133→   - HTML (.html)
   134→   - PDF (.pdf)
   135→2. The file will be downloaded in your selected format
   136→
   137→### Project Management
   138→
   139→1. Access past analysis results from the "Projects" tab
   140→2. Each project is automatically saved, and you can resume editing at any time
   141→3. Share your projects with other users using the "Share" button
   142→

   144→
   145→- Node.js 18 or higher
   146→- Vercel account (with Blob store set up)
   147→- Mistral AI account and API key

   164→- Mistral AI (OCR processing)
   165→- TailwindCSS (styling)
   166→- React Markdown (markdown rendering)
   167→
   168→## Troubleshooting
   169→
   170→- **Unable to upload PDF**
   171→
   172→  - Ensure the file size is 20MB or less (for server uploads)
   173→  - Try clearing your browser cache
   174→
   175→- **Analysis fails**
   176→
   177→  - Check if the PDF is encrypted
   178→  - For scanned PDFs, check if the image quality is sufficient
   179→
   180→- **API errors displayed**
   181→  - Verify that environment variables are correctly set
   182→  - Check the expiration date and usage limits of your Mistral API key
   183→  - Ensure that your Vercel Blob token is valid

## Comprehensive Codebase Analysis Report

### 1. **Framework & Language**

### 3. **High-Level Architecture**

```
/app

  │   └── page.tsx         # Main page component (client-side FileUploader)

/jest.config.js           # Jest with ts-jest preset

**13 Supported Languages** (`Language` type in `app/lib/i18n.ts`):
- English (en), Japanese (ja), Korean (ko), Chinese (zh)
- German (de), French (fr), Spanish (es), Italian (it)
- Portuguese (pt), Russian (ru), Arabic (ar), Hindi (hi), Dutch (nl)

**Implementation**:
- **Middleware** (`middleware.ts`): Analyzes `Accept-Language` header, maps browser language to supported languages, redirects root `/` to `/{lang}`
- **Routing**: Path-based URLs (e.g., `/en`, `/ja`, `/ko`) using Next.js dynamic route segments
- **Legacy support**: Redirects old query-param URLs (`?lang=en`) to new path-based URLs (301 redirect)
- **Translations**: Full translation objects in `i18n.ts` covering UI text, buttons, errors, form labels (~80+ keys)
- **SEO**: Language metadata with hrefLang alternates, structured data (JSON-LD), canonicalPath per language

**Request Flow**:
1. User visits `/` → Middleware redirects to `/{preferredLanguage}`
2. User visits `/en` (example) → Routes to `app/[lang]/page.tsx`
3. Layout wraps page with language metadata in `app/[lang]/layout.tsx`
4. Server actions in `/action` handle OCR, S3 operations

**Dynamic Routes**:
- `app/[lang]/layout.tsx` - Wraps page with language-specific metadata
- `app/[lang]/page.tsx` - Main FileUploader component
- Root `page.tsx` - Redirect only (uses Next.js `redirect()`)

**Static Parameters**: Generated via `generateStaticParams()` for all 13 languages (SSG)

1. **PDF Upload** - Drag & drop or file picker, max 20MB
2. **Image Upload** - Support for image files (direct OCR without S3)
3. **OCR Processing** - Mistral AI's `mistral-ocr-latest` model

5. **Multi-Tab View**:

   - Text tab: Raw markdown code view per page

# PDF to Markdown

This application is a tool for uploading PDF files and analyzing their content using Mistral AI's OCR capabilities.

## Getting Mistral AI API Key

2. Generate an API key from the dashboard
3. Store the generated API key securely

## Vercel Blob Setup

Before deploying the application, you need to set up Vercel Blob storage:

1. **Create a Vercel project**

   - Access [Vercel](https://vercel.com/) to sign up/log in
   - Click "New Project" to create a new project

2. **Create a Vercel Blob store**

   - Select the "Storage" tab in the project dashboard
   - Click the "Connect Database" button
   - Select "Blob" in the "Create New" tab and click the "Continue" button
   - Configure the following settings:
     - Name: Any name (e.g., "PDF Storage")
     - Select "Create a new Blob store"
     - Select the environments where you want to add environment variables (typically all environments)
     - Optionally change the environment variable prefix in "Advanced Options"
   - Click the "Create" button to create the store

3. **Set up environment variables**

   - When the Blob store is created, the following environment variable will be automatically added to your project:
     - `BLOB_READ_WRITE_TOKEN`
   - To use this environment variable in your local development environment, pull the environment variables using Vercel CLI:
     ```bash
     vercel env pull
     ```

Once these settings are complete, you can proceed with deploying the application.

## Deploy on Vercel

Follow these steps to deploy the application on Vercel:

1. **Clone the repository**

   ```bash
   git clone https://github.com/link2004/pdf2md.git
   cd pdf2md
   ```

2. **Copy the .env.example file**

   ```bash
   cp .env.example .env
   ```

3. **Set up the required environment variables in the .env file**

   - Get `BLOB_READ_WRITE_TOKEN` from your Vercel dashboard and set it
   - Get `MISTRAL_API_KEY` from your Mistral AI account and set it

   - Click on "New Project"
   - Import your repository from GitHub
   - Add the same environment variables as in your `.env` file in the "Environment Variables" section
   - Click on the "Deploy" button

5. **Verify the deployment**
   - Once deployment is complete, access the provided URL to confirm that the application is working properly

Note: Environment variables contain sensitive information, so do not commit your `.env` file to public repositories like GitHub. Instead, set the environment variables directly in the Vercel dashboard.

- PDF file upload
- PDF storage in Vercel Blob
- PDF analysis using Mistral AI's OCR capabilities
- Display and editing of analysis results
- Export functionality in Markdown format

## Commands

```bash
npm run dev          # Dev server with Turbopack
npm run build        # Production build

```

## Architecture

Next.js 15 app (TypeScript, React 19, TailwindCSS 4) that converts PDFs to Markdown using Mistral AI OCR. Deployed on Vercel.

### Request Flow

1. `middleware.ts` detects browser language from `Accept-Language` header, redirects `/` to `/{lang}` (13 languages)
2. `app/[lang]/page.tsx` renders the FileUploader (client component)
3. User uploads PDF → server action `app/action/mistral.ts` uploads to S3, gets signed URL, calls Mistral OCR, deletes from S3
4. Image uploads skip S3 — sent directly as base64 to Mistral
5. Results displayed as rendered markdown with KaTeX math support, exportable as ZIP or markdown

### Key Directories

- `app/[lang]/` — Dynamic language route (layout.tsx handles SEO metadata/hreflang, page.tsx renders uploader)
- `app/action/` — Server actions: `mistral.ts` (OCR), `s3.ts` (AWS S3 ops), `downloadHelper.ts` (ZIP export)
- `app/components/` — UI: FileUploader, Header (tabs/copy/download), OcrResultView (markdown preview), Footer
- `app/lib/` — `i18n.ts` (13-language translations, ~80+ keys), `metadata.ts` (per-language SEO metadata with JSON-LD)

### i18n

Path-based routing (`/en`, `/ja`, `/ko`, etc.) with 13 languages. The `Language` type and all translations live in `app/lib/i18n.ts`. Middleware handles detection and legacy query-param redirects (`?lang=en` → `/en`). Static params generated for all languages via `generateStaticParams()`.

### External Services

- **Mistral AI** (`mistral-ocr-latest` model) — OCR processing
- **AWS S3** — Temporary PDF storage (uploaded, signed URL created for Mistral, then deleted)
- **Vercel** — Hosting, analytics (`@vercel/analytics`)

### Environment Variables

```
MISTRAL_API_KEY, AWS_REGION, AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, AWS_S3_BUCKET_NAME
```

## Configuration Notes

- `next.config.ts`: Server action body size limit set to 20MB for PDF uploads
- `tsconfig.json`: Path alias `@/*` maps to project root
- Tests use `jest.setup.js` which loads `.env.local`
- Note: README mentions Vercel Blob but the codebase has migrated to AWS S3

S3を排除し、`PDF → Base64 → Mistral OCR API → Markdown` のシンプルなパイプラインとする。

## 作成ファイル

`extracted/` ディレクトリに以下を作成:

### 1. `extracted/pdf2md.ts` — コア変換関数

```
convertPdfToMarkdown(pdfPath: string, options?) → { pages: Page[], markdown: string }
convertImageToMarkdown(imagePath: string, options?) → { pages: Page[], markdown: string }
```

- ファイルをfsで読み取り → Base64変換 → Mistral OCR APIにデータURLとして送信
- S3不要、環境変数は `MISTRAL_API_KEY` のみ
- `includeImageBase64` オプションで画像抽出の有無を制御
- 全ページ結合したmarkdown文字列も返す

### 2. `extracted/cli.ts` — CLIエントリポイント

```bash
npx tsx extracted/cli.ts input.pdf                    # stdout にmarkdown出力
npx tsx extracted/cli.ts input.pdf -o output.md       # ファイルに書き出し
npx tsx extracted/cli.ts input.pdf -o output.md --no-images  # 画像抽出なし
```

- 引数パース（外部依存なし、process.argvを直接処理）
- 結果をstdoutまたはファイルに出力

### 3. `extracted/README.md` — 使い方

## 依存関係

- `@mistralai/mistralai` — 既存のpackage.jsonから利用（追加インストール不要）
- Node.js fs/path — 標準ライブラリ
- **S3関連は一切不要**

## 検証方法

```bash
export MISTRAL_API_KEY=your_key
npx tsx extracted/cli.ts test.pdf
```
